Definition: strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then
BiblicalUsage: 1) then, now, so; 1a) (who) then, (what) then (with interrog); 1b) then (with imperative-i.e. know then); 1c) if...then (with adv)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
